question: Does the current GEO deposit resolve the library-to-mouse and author-state joins missing from A5 replication qualification?
decision: Compare newly retrieved deposited fields with the existing source audit and determine whether the original replication hold can be lifted.
strongest_rival: Fifty-six library identifiers can represent fewer animals, and source vocabulary without barcode labels cannot establish eligible biological arms.
discriminator: Recover explicit deposited sample membership, assays and identity fields; distinguish a missing join from demonstrated independent biological preparations.
exposure_record: Published study findings, existing repository results and selected GEO metadata were inspected before this freeze. No expression values are read by this metadata run; the run is not blind validation.
biological_unit: Animal, donor or independent source preparation; unresolved at the intended comparison level.
nesting_and_overlap: GEO samples are library records and may share animals, pools, preparations, wells or parent series. No cross-study independence or sample-to-animal mapping is inferred by this parser.
population_and_selection: All SAMPLE entities declared by each specified GEO SOFT family file; no expression-based filtering or sample exclusion.
contrast: Descriptive comparison of deposited identity fields and sample membership against the scientific question; no gene-level or population contrast.
endpoint: Metadata inventory: series and sample IDs, titles, species, assay strategy, subseries memberships, characteristic-key coverage and available file locators.
methods: Parse local SOFT headers and a fixed metadata-field allowlist. Require unique accession IDs and exact series/sample membership. Export identity fields and summaries; do not export protocol text or treatment values. Never convert record counts into biological-unit counts.
missingness_and_exclusions: Missing identity fields remain missing; incomplete or conflicting accession joins stop extraction. No sample is silently dropped and no animal identity is imputed.
multiplicity: No hypothesis tests or inferential comparisons are performed.
precision_basis: This is a deposited-metadata inventory, not a sample-size or power justification; biological-unit variance remains unknown.
interpretation_limit: An accession inventory does not establish replication, fate linkage, receptor activity, protein delivery, causal mechanisms or experimental readiness. Public file names are not audited expression contents.
stop_rule: Stop if SOFT identity/membership checks fail. After successful extraction, hold any scientific contrast whose units, timing, endpoint or source attribution remain unresolved; do not score expression under this contract.
amendment_reason: Initial registered metadata qualification; prior source and outcome exposure is explicit. Historical biological results and contracts remain unchanged.
